title: Goat Range Park Br FSR 7051.02 (June 13, 2025)
source_text: Goat Range Park Br FSR 7051.02 (June 13, 2025): This FSR is located at 47km on Hwy 31, approximately 4.5km southeast of Trout Lake, and provides access into the Healy Creek watershed. Road is closed to all traffic at the 0.0 km bridge N7-266 for public safety due to deteriorated bridge deck conditions. No planned repair date.
